comments.text:
I’ve done research today. There is no verifiable drilling into the mountain up the valley, up on the mountain. All I could find is lower down near the valley. I would like to know if you have some details I can look into. Grateful. 

I learned some other things that were left out of the videos I’ve seen. The situation looks hopeful for those at one of the hydroelectric stations where a group is trapped in a room waiting for a delicate rescue. The report I found said it looks pretty grim for the other stations, but hard work continues. It is a very tricky situation. 

Drones are being used for many reasons providing a valuable tool in many delicate and challenging situation. 

The last good news I found is that World Central Kitchen is there providing food and coordination with local organizations and resources. I can’t verify but my detailed information source said they are providing local food and snacks to workers and survivors. It sounds like a massive 3 country coordination and especially challenging because of the restricted  nature of the terrain and the massive damage. Also the infrastructure has been almost totally wiped out in the valleys of the slides. So water, everything are huge issues. 

If you pray, they are in great need. So much devastation, loss of life and logistical challenges. 3 countries not real friendly are having to cooperate. Lots going on. 

Sorry for the long post.
